description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Triniform with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform, adding {C}{C}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing the Golems, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Cogwork Assembler to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.
